clusters.dom:
Danielle Ellis
She/Her
Senior Clinical Advisor
Danielle brings over 15 years of specialist experience in women’s health, with a strong focus on fertility care. Danielle has led donation care teams, gaining deep expertise in both donor and recipient support through complex fertility journeys. She is committed to providing informed, compassionate, and patient-centred care. As a dedicated patient advocate, Danielle works to ensure everyone can access the right clinical support, enabling patients to make informed decisions while navigating the legal and medical aspects of fertility with confidence.
Special interests:
Fertility preservation
Surrogacy
Sperm and egg donation
LinkedIn
Katie Clarke
She/Her
CLinical advisor
Katie has been a qualified nurse since 2020 with experience in acute medical care. In 2022, she found a love for Fertility Nursing and a passion for empowering individuals on their reproductive health journeys. With a strong commitment to patient-centred care, Katie is dedicated to providing guidance, education and support, helping patients make informed and confident decisions about their fertility and overall wellbeing. 
Special interests:
Fertility Treatment, Family Planning and Fertility Preservation including egg freezing
Pregnancy loss and miscarriage support
LinkedIn
Sarah Feldman
She/Her
Senior Patient Advisor
Sarah has 3 years of experience through her work in the postpartum ward as a Patient Care Associate, helping new parents and babies transition from labour. She has experience in health literacy in pregnancy and hands-on postpartum care. She is dedicated to providing health equity and education about fertility and pregnancy.
Special interests:
Fertility treatment and planning
Contraception advice
LinkedIn

She/Her
Fertifa Midwife

She has significant experience working in emergency teams and in intrapartum diabetes care. She has previously worked in leading London hospitals, looking after patients with complex medical conditions that range from pregnancy complications, labour issues and the immediate postnatal period.
Special interests:
Advice and support during pregnancy and beyond
Birth options and preferences

Fertility treatment planning, for all fertility treatments

Danielle Ellis
She/Her
Senior Clinical Advisor
Danielle brings over 15 years of specialist experience in women’s health, with a strong focus on fertility care. Danielle has led donation care teams, gaining deep expertise in both donor and recipient support through complex fertility journeys. She is committed to providing informed, compassionate, and patient-centred care. As a dedicated patient advocate, Danielle works to ensure everyone can access the right clinical support, enabling patients to make informed decisions while navigating the legal and medical aspects of fertility with confidence.
Special interests:
Fertility preservation
Surrogacy
Sperm and egg donation
LinkedIn
Katie Clarke
She/Her
CLinical advisor
Katie has been a qualified nurse since 2020 with experience in acute medical care. In 2022, she found a love for Fertility Nursing and a passion for empowering individuals on their reproductive health journeys. With a strong commitment to patient-centred care, Katie is dedicated to providing guidance, education and support, helping patients make informed and confident decisions about their fertility and overall wellbeing. 
Special interests:
Fertility Treatment, Family Planning and Fertility Preservation including egg freezing
Pregnancy loss and miscarriage support
LinkedIn
Sarah Feldman
She/Her
Senior Patient Advisor
Sarah has 3 years of experience through her work in the postpartum ward as a Patient Care Associate, helping new parents and babies transition from labour. She has experience in health literacy in pregnancy and hands-on postpartum care. She is dedicated to providing health equity and education about fertility and pregnancy.
Special interests:
Fertility treatment and planning
Contraception advice

She has significant experience working in emergency teams and in intrapartum diabetes care. She has previously worked in leading London hospitals, looking after patients with complex medical conditions that range from pregnancy complications, labour issues and the immediate postnatal period.

Advice and support during pregnancy and beyond
Birth options and preferences
